thread:
alex: FYI seeing a sustained uptick in correctable ECC + some nodes dropping kvcache in eu-north-1 rack-22. packet loss on top-of-rack looks correlated.

oncall-bot: ALERT: cluster-eu-north health degraded — 12 nodes reporting ECC > 0.5%/hr, 3 nodes flapping network links. See /alerts/2034567890

cheng: copying logs now, pulling telemetry. can someone run a quick `ipmitool sdr` on rack-22-03 and rack-22-07? suspected PSU/thermal not just ECC.

maria: @cheng running `infractl node-metrics --node rack-22-03 --since 15m` gave this snippet:
```
GPU0 correctable_errors: 214
GPU1 correctable_errors: 198
temp_gpu: 83C
link_errors: 3 (transient)
```

nate: heat + errors + link flaps = risk of uncorrectable. recommend draining the 4 worst nodes in rack-22 now and triggering canary shift to eu-west and dedicated pool. Low-latency SLOs will see degradation but better than U/O.

alex: Agreed. Plan: 1) drain rack-22-03/04/07/09 2) policy: prefer eu-west then ap-sg fallback 3) enable dedicated-burst for 2h 4) open vendor RMA for GPUs on rack-22-03/07. Anyone object? @maria @cheng

maria: no objections. running drain commands now: 
```
infractl drain --node rack-22-03 --reason "ECC spike + link flap" --no-new-allocs
infractl drain --node rack-22-04 --reason "ECC spike"
```

cheng: started node evac, hitting a small issue where some long-running KV-cache sessions don't close quickly. adding `--force-grace 120s` for the last two nodes.

infra-ops-bot: ACTION: routing policy updated: spillover sequence eu-west-1 -> ap-sg-1; autoscaler invoked: +6 dedicated workers; burst pool enabled for team=prod for 2h. Estimated cost delta: +$1.6k over 2h (egress + dedicated instances).

nate: tagging finance:heads about the temporary cost. @alex @maria note that cross-region egress will also count against reserved bandwidth quotas — if traffic >50Mbps sustained we'll throttle. Suggest enabling compression for embeddings path for the duration.

alex: good call. @cheng can you flip on gzip for the embeddings endpoint at the edge? That's the bulk.

cheng: enabled gzip via edge-config v18.2 (no restart). Also adjusted routing to prefer eu-west capacity with session affinity where possible.

maria: vendor ticket 9981 opened for ECC/PSU inspection. ETA for field tech: 26h. RMA pre-approval queued. Logged parts order for 8x GPUs and 2 PSUs for rack-22.

alex: ops checklist: 1) drain complete? 2) traffic shifted? 3) monitor SLOs and error rates 4) postmortem owner

maria: drains completed for the four nodes, traffic shifted per infra-ops-bot, canary latency + p99 increased ~12% in eu-west but under alert thresholds. Still seeing intermittent link-level drops on rack-22-08 — marking for replacement as well.

nate: I'll keep an eye on billing alerts and keep finance in the loop. starting a short-lived capacity reservation to avoid scaling churn.

alex: thanks all. follow-ups: schedule physical swap for rack-22 in next RMA window, add a runbook step to detect ECC+link correlation and auto-quarantine node before uncorrectable occurs. assigning postmortem to @cheng.

cheng: acknowledged. I'll capture timeline, telemetry, and recommended kernel/firmware roll for the rack.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigation in place, monitoring. next update in 30m or on significant state change. :eyes:
